book_title: The Rib Tips Workbook: Perfecting Your Marriage
author: Sheena N Broughton
book_description: The Rib Tips is simply giving tips to married couples to save and help build more love between the two. These tips came from God himself to share with other couples to save their marriage and build a stronger foundation. However, some of these tips came from personal experiences in my marriage that I was led to share with others. Furthermore, I have created a workbook that couples can now work on together. I believe this workbook will help bring forth oneness, and a better understanding of the book, as well as giving couples with to work on in their marriage.Show more
